run.title: Qahwa Lab Ramadan Campaign
run.objective: Launch the Ramadan campaign for our specialty coffee brand Qahwa Lab by November 20: a bilingual landing page, a launch email sequence and a two-week social plan.
run.summary: Launch the Ramadan campaign for Qahwa Lab with a bilingual landing page, email sequence, and social media plan by November 20.

tasks.title: Research campaign requirements and offers
tasks.description: Gather all details regarding the Ramadan 20% discount offer, free delivery conditions, and brand voice guidelines.
acceptanceCriteria: Document lists offer terms and key brand messaging points.

routing.rationale: Routing unavailable; a person confirms this task.

tasks.title: Draft bilingual landing page copy
tasks.description: Write compelling copy for the Ramadan landing page highlighting the specialty coffee blend and offers in Arabic and English.
acceptanceCriteria: Landing page copy is provided in both Arabic and English.
Includes clear call to action and offer terms.

routing.rationale: Routing unavailable; a person confirms this task.

tasks.title: Design landing page wireframe and assets
tasks.description: Create visual concepts and wireframes for the bilingual landing page matching the Qahwa Lab brand identity.
acceptanceCriteria: Visual layouts and design assets are delivered.

routing.rationale: Routing unavailable; a person confirms this task.

tasks.title: Draft launch email sequence
tasks.description: Write a three-part email sequence announcing the Ramadan special offer to existing customers in Arabic and English.
acceptanceCriteria: Three email drafts covering announcement, reminder, and last chance are complete.

routing.rationale: Routing unavailable; a person confirms this task.

tasks.title: Create two-week social media plan
tasks.description: Develop a content calendar and post copy for two weeks of Ramadan social media promotion across platforms.
acceptanceCriteria: Content calendar lists post dates, visuals needed, and bilingual captions.

routing.rationale: Routing unavailable; a person confirms this task.

tasks.title: Review and approve campaign materials
tasks.description: Sara Al-Qahtani and Omar Haddad review all copy, designs, emails, and social plans for final sign-off.
acceptanceCriteria: All campaign assets are formally approved by the marketing team.

routing.rationale: Routing unavailable; a person confirms this task.

tasks.title: Publish landing page and schedule emails
tasks.description: Set up and publish the landing page and load the email sequence into the marketing platform for the November 20 launch.

routing.rationale: Routing unavailable; a person confirms this task.
